Foodify · clickable prototype · rendered from the theme
A working prototype of the new letsfoodify.com, generated from the real WordPress theme. Browse, filter, open any product, add to the cart, check out, and find the order in your account. In the cart, try the partner code NALIN10.
What is real and what is not

Real: the layout, type, colours and every component come from the theme the developer installs. The cart follows the shop's actual rules — free delivery from ₹599 after codes, ₹59 below it, ₹25 off for paying online, cash on delivery on every order.

Stood in for: Razorpay's payment window (a simulated payment), the SMS that carries the sign-in code (any six digits work), and food photography (coloured bowls, pending the shoot). Nothing here is sent anywhere; the prototype remembers your cart and orders in this browser only, and Reset clears them.

Invented for the prototype, awaiting your word: the FSSAI licence number (10012345000001), the same-day NCR dispatch promise, the "Complete the meal" pairing, the combo boxes with their contents and prices, each product's price, ingredients, allergens, nutrition, taste notes, cooked weight, FAQ and reviews, and the partner code. The shop holds 44 products, as the live site does, but only the observed SKUs are real names (Dal Fry, Dal Makhni, Idli Sambhar, Pav Bhaji, Palak Gravy, Dal Khichdi, Aloo ka Mazaa, Super Millet Idli, the millet-beetroot cheela, Masala Chai, Lemon Masala Tea, Coconut Red Chutney, Schezwan Rice); the rest stand in until Foodify sends its list. Allergens are worked out from each ingredient list against FSSAI's declarable allergens, so they are only as right as the ingredients.

Settings Foodify has to choose, filled in here so the features can be tried: delivery zones and days for the PIN check, box sizes and discounts (3 · 6 · 9 packs at 5 · 10 · 12% off), a 7-day window to report a problem, referral amounts (give ₹100, get ₹100 on a first order over ₹499), and the review photos (drawn bowls). On the live site each of these features stays hidden until its setting is entered. WhatsApp updates, repeat-order reminders and cart reminders also send real messages, so they ship switched off; nothing here is sent anywhere. The live site prints NOT CONFIGURED for a licence it has not been given — nothing here is live until you confirm it.

    How it works

    Photography placeholder — prepared Dal Makhni, steam rising

    No preservatives

    Shelf life comes from drying, not chemistry.

    9–12 month shelf life

    Printed on every pack and every product page.

    FSSAI licensed

    10012345000001, on pack and on invoice.

    Made in Noida

    Our own kitchen. Not white-labelled.

    Express in three steps

    STEP 1

    Tear the pack

    Empty the contents into a bowl.

    STEP 2

    Add hot water

    Stir well and cover.

    STEP 3

    Wait 6 minutes

    Eat.

    Sorted by how you make it

    Not by cuisine, not by price. The question is how much effort you have tonight.

                                                                                                                    Paying

                                                                                                                    • Pay now by UPI, card or netbanking, and ₹25 comes off the order.

                                                                                                                          My account

                                                                                                                          Our story

                                                                                                                          Instant, preservative-free, home-style Indian food — dal, idli, khichdi, chai and chutney — that comes back to life with hot water, a few minutes on the stove, or a stir of cold water.

                                                                                                                          It is made for the places a kitchen is not: a train berth, a hostel room, a hotel kettle, an office desk, a parent who cooks less than they used to. Every pack keeps for nine to twelve months without preservatives.

                                                                                                                          To come from Foodify. The founder's story, in Nalin's words, and photographs of the kitchen and the team.
